purpose: Verified contract for routing natural-language property questions to the correct legal-life investigation or general-information pathway.
question_rule: Preserve the original question and classify intent before selecting evidence or legal analysis.
scope_rule: Property and time scope are established before property-specific conclusions are attempted.
routing_rule: Question type determines the minimum evidence and legal-analysis components required.
clarification_rule: Only material routing or retrieval blockers justify clarification.
general_info_rule: General legal questions should not be converted into unnecessary property investigations.
verification_boundary: The question engine routes work; it does not itself establish property facts or legal conclusions.
